source: Cloudflare dashboard production D1 console, read-only SELECT

queries.sql: SELECT revision, conclusion, state, attempts, last_error FROM work_status_outbox WHERE check_id='107857484011' AND revision IN (14,15,16) ORDER BY revision;
SELECT id, desired_revision, delivered_revision, ambiguous FROM work_checks WHERE id='107857484011';

limits: The live GitHub check URL shows only the final success. The D1 outbox records the delivered intermediate failure but does not independently capture the earlier GitHub response body.
